mapper.sql: ( SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN R.RN = 1 THEN R.CLOSE_PRICE END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN R.RN = 6 THEN R.CLOSE_PRICE END), 0) - 1) * 100, 2) FROM ( SELECT P.CLOSE_PRICE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = S.ID AND P.TRADE_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 20 ) R )
mapper.select: SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME , AS RET5 FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK' AND S.LAST_CLOSE IS NOT NULL AND S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING IS NOT NULL ORDER BY S.LAST_CLOSE * S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT I.ID AS ITEM_ID ,I.TRADE_DATE ,I.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,I.SEQ ,I.BOT_PICK ,I.BASE_DATE ,I.BASE_CLOSE ,I.RESULT_CLOSE ,I.RESULT ,S.LAST_CLOSE , AS RET5 ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V WHERE V.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND V.PICK = 'UP')::INT AS UP_COUNT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V WHERE V.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND V.PICK = 'DOWN')::INT AS DOWN_COUNT ,(SELECT V.PICK FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V WHERE V.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND V.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AS PICK ,(SELECT V.CORRECT FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V WHERE V.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND V.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AS CORRECT FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM I JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = I.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.TRADE_DATE = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY I.SEQ
SELECT I.ID AS ITEM_ID ,I.TRADE_DATE ,I.STOCK_ID ,I.RESULT FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.ID = #{itemId}
SELECT I.ID AS ITEM_ID ,I.TRADE_DATE ,I.STOCK_ID FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.RESULT IS NULL AND I.TRADE_DATE <= #{upTo} ORDER BY I.TRADE_DATE, I.SEQ
SELECT P.TRADE_DATE AS BASE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE AS BASE_CLOSE FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND P.TRADE_DATE < #{tradeDate} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE T_PREDICT_VOTE SET CORRECT = CASE WHEN #{result} IN ('UP', 'DOWN') THEN PICK = #{result} END WHERE 1=1 AND ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(TRADE_DATE) FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IS NOT NULL

SELECT I.TRADE_DATE ,I.SEQ ,V.CORRECT FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V JOIN T_PREDICT_ITEM I ON I.ID = V.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND V.USER_ID = #{userId} AND V.CORRECT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY I.TRADE_DATE DESC, I.SEQ DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS GRADED ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE BOT_PICK = RESULT)::INT AS HITS FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('UP', 'DOWN') AND BOT_PICK IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS GRADED ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.MAJORITY = X.RESULT)::INT AS HITS FROM ( SELECT I.RESULT ,CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN V.PICK = 'UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN V.PICK = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'UP' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN V.PICK = 'UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN V.PICK = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'DOWN' END AS MAJORITY FROM T_PREDICT_ITEM I JOIN T_PREDICT_VOTE V ON V.ITEM_ID = I.ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.RESULT IN ('UP', 'DOWN') GROUP BY I.ID, I.RESULT ) X WHERE 1=1 AND X.MAJORITY IS NOT NULL
